journey.name: TL-21 A checkbox is inert while its own write is in flight
journey.description:
REGRESSION GUARD. This journey used to assert the defect: the checkbox rendered `task.isCompleted`, which is the cache, which does not change until the write returns - so a second tap during the first write computed its value from the same stale `false` and sent "complete" again. Two taps that a user reads as complete-then-undo left the task complete, with nothing to say a tap had been absorbed. Filed as issue #17 and now fixed the way `TaskEditorViewModel.onSave` already handles the same race: the row is held for the duration of its write and the control is disabled.
The second tap still does not toggle the row back - the point of the fix is that it no longer looks as though it should. The control is visibly inert while the call is out, which is both the signal the user was missing and what stops the duplicate write.
Invisible to a unit test at the UI level: a test dispatcher lets the first call complete before the second tap is dispatched, which is exactly the interleaving that does not happen on a device. Pinning the latency at 3000 ms makes the real one reachable by hand.
Reading disabled state: `qa/README.md` records that it lives on the clickable parent rather than on the label, so match the wrapping node.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0 --es qa_latency_ms 3000

actions.action: Verify that the "Renew domain registration" row has an unchecked checkbox
Tap the checkbox with the content description "Mark complete" on the "Renew domain registration" row
Verify, while the write is still in flight, that this checkbox now reports itself disabled
Immediately tap that same checkbox a second time, within half a second, while the first write is still in flight
Wait ten seconds for the write to finish
Verify that the "Renew domain registration" row has a checked checkbox
Verify that the "Renew domain registration" title is struck through
Verify that no error message is on screen
Verify that the checkbox on that row is now described as "Mark incomplete" and is enabled again
Tap that checkbox once and wait ten seconds
Verify that the row is unchecked again, so the control is only held for the duration of a write
